summary: Treed kerb near the main road junction; homes 14-16 m away.
reasons: Cars already park along this kerb
Close to the junction and main road

best_section.where: North side of York Street, under trees just up from the main road corner

drivers.seclusion: Nearest homes are 14 m and 16 m away across the street; the north-side house starts about 19 m along.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street with parked cars along the kerb, so room to stop is fine.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street beside a busy main road junction.
drivers.convention: Resident cars park along both kerbs; no campers seen.

flags: Noise from the adjoining main road
Dwellings 14-16 m away on both sides
sun_shade: Mature trees shade the corner end; morning sun from the east, shaded by houses to the north.
